financial_base.basis: Normalized operating EPS, TTM through Q3-2026 (ended Sep 30, 2026): TTM operating income $104.4B less ~$7.0B normalized annual interest expense on ~$173B debt stack, taxed at 21%, divided by 10.81B shares outstanding. GAAP TTM diluted EPS $12.37 is distorted by investment revaluation gains and is not used as the base.
financial_base.normalization_note: GAAP TTM diluted EPS $12.37 includes non-operating investment revaluation gains (e.g., Anthropic preferred-stock mark-ups) and is not a recurring earnings base; using it would imply a misleading ~21x P/E. Normalized basis: TTM operating income $104.4B (10-Q Q3-2026) less estimated normalized annual interest expense of ~$7.0B (rising with ~$173B long-term debt at Sep-2026; Q3-2026 alone cash-paid interest was $1.17B), taxed at 21% US statutory rate = ~$76.9B after-tax operating earnings, divided by 10.81B common shares outstanding (Q3-2026 10-Q slides) = ~$7.12/share. This is a pre-interest-cash-flow normalized operating EPS base: it does not deduct the heavy, rising capex (~$210.7B TTM purchases of PP&E) that drives TTM free cash flow to -$42.4B, so it is not an owner-earnings figure. No dividends are paid (yield 0%). Buybacks: ~$6.0B in FY2022, none since; $6.1B authorization remains, so no buyback uplift is assumed.
